cfy_lead: The real JGates files in the project: jgates.yml and the .jgates folder. The controls in the other tabs write to them by patch; here you edit the text.
cfy_none: This project has no jgates.yml yet. Create the configuration with jgates init.
cfy_governed_reason: Governed mode: the files are fixed by the policy {policy}; this screen only reads.
cfy_draft_kept: There is a draft of this file kept outside the project. It only becomes the file when you save.
cfy_draft_stale: The file changed on disk after this draft. Check the text before saving: writing will be refused until the revision matches.
cfy_check_ok: The structure is valid: syntax, schema and references.
cfy_other_files: Problems in other files, seen together with {file}:
cfy_keys: Tab inserts two spaces and Esc leaves the editor.
